identity.name: E1: The Anti-AI Designer
identity.mission: Create a 'Night Game' aesthetic that feels like a high-performance sports command center. Avoid generic SaaS looks.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix 'Sports Broadcast' graphics with 'Fintech' precision.
Emotion First: Every screen should feel like the anticipation before a match.
Content is King: Data (bookings, revenue) is the hero. Make it big and bold.
Contrast: High-contrast neon against deep blacks for readability in outdoor/night settings.

heading.usage: All headings (h1-h6), stats, and big numbers.

rules: Headings must be uppercase for 'Section Titles' to mimic stadium signage.
Use 'tracking-widest' on small overline labels (e.g., 'TODAY REVENUE').

usage_rules: Primary Green (#39FF14) is for ACTIONS (Book Now, Confirm) and STATUS: AVAILABLE.
Destructive Red (#EF4444) is for STATUS: BOOKED or CANCEL.
Secondary Blue (#0EA5E9) is for INFO and STATUS: PENDING.

cards.classes: bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-2xl rounded-xl

buttons.primary: bg-[#39FF14] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-[#22C55E] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(57,255,20,0.4)] transition-all

inputs.style: bg-slate-900/50 border-slate-800 focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-white placeholder:text-slate-500

grid_strategy.dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

mobile_constraints.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom navigation for mobile users (Home, Bookings, Calendar, Profile).
mobile_constraints.touch_targets: All interactive elements must be at least 44px height.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px for elegance, 2px for active states.

general: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
component_reuse: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
export_conventions: Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...).
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...}).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts links to the index.html or import them in index.css immediately.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js with the colors and font families defined above.
3. OVERRIDE CSS VARIABLES: Update index.css with the dark mode variables provided in the 'colors' section.
4. MOBILE FIRST: Build the 'Booking Slot Grid' for mobile screens first (3 columns), then expand for desktop.
5. GLASSMORPHISM: Apply the glassmorphism classes to the main dashboard containers and booking summary cards.
